name: Robot Workshop
blurb: Steel plates and hazard stripes. Red gear against blue bolt.
status: APPROVED direction. Colors and geometry final; sounds and animations still to author.
note: A full override of Neon, not a tint. Screens 4a in the design file. Style rules: flat saturated fills, a 3-4px #16202b outline on EVERY element, solid offset drop shadows (0 Npx 0) instead of blurred shadows, chunky radii. Nothing is soft-glowed except the forced-quadrant ring.

color.outlineWidth: 3px on chips and quadrants, 4px on buttons and panels, 5px on modals

playerOne.name: gear
playerOne.build: two stacked rounded squares (0deg + 45deg) in #ff4433 over a #16202b silhouette 2.5px larger, a #ff6a55 inner circle with an inset top highlight, and a #16202b centre hole

playerTwo.name: hex bolt
playerTwo.build: hexagon clip-path polygon(25% 2%,75% 2%,100% 50%,75% 98%,25% 98%,0 50%) in #2bc4f5 over a #16202b hexagon 2.5px larger, a white 45% trapezoid highlight across the top, and a #16202b centre hole

catGame.name: rust / SCRAP
catGame.build: three overlapping rust radial-gradients (#d67a3c, #a05626, #784622) on #8a6a4a, with a 700-weight 11px SCRAP label in #fff2df
catGame.label: SCRAP

board.quadrantRivets: 4px #c9d6e3 circles with a 1.5px #16202b ring, one per quadrant corner, inset 4px
board.smallGridLines: 3px #2b3a4c rounded bars, inset 7% from each end, with a 1px white-22% lit edge — scored seams in the plate
board.bigGridLines: 11px hazard girders laid ACROSS the gaps (never touching a quadrant): repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#ffc82c 0 7px,#16202b 7px 14px), 0 0 0 2.5px #16202b, 0 3px 6px rgba(10,18,26,.5), radius 3, positioned at 32.8% and 67.2%, inset -4px on the cross axis

controls.buttonPrimary: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd75a,#ffb700), text #16202b, 0 0 0 4px #16202b + 0 7px 0 #b37c00 + inset 0 4px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5), radius 16, padding 22, 26px/700
controls.scoreChip: #7b8fa6 plate, radius 12, 0 0 0 3px #16202b + 0 4px 0 #2b3a4c; the active player's chip swaps to their color with their own shadow step
controls.titlePlate: #2b3a4c, radius 16, 0 0 0 4px #16202b + 0 7px 0 #1b2735 — dark ON PURPOSE so the #ffc82c wordmark clears 4.5:1

type.note: Built for ages 5-8: heavier and larger than Neon throughout. 700 weight is the default for anything a child reads, not an emphasis.

copy.voice: Short, loud, kid-facing. Players are named by color, not 'Player One'.

animation.note: Same timings as Neon; only the character changes — mechanical, not bouncy.

contrastNotes: Labels on saturated chips (#ff4433, #2bc4f5) use a near-black of their own hue, NOT white — white measured 2.0-3.4:1 and failed.
The wordmark plate is dark for the same reason. Do not lighten it back.
